scope: R4: opt-in loading of the native desktop provider at Hyprland start in the user session

design.optIn: ~/.config/bwm/native-desktops.json {"version":1,"enabled":true} via native-desktops.py enable|disable (BWM-managed, not bwm/user text config); effective at next login
design.startup: autostart.sh block 9 runs native-desktops.py startup in background once per Hyprland start: checks opt-in, module installed and built for the running commit, writes a pending guard, hyprctl plugin load, enables plugin:bwm_plasma_desktops:enabled, verifies the diagnostic, writes $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/bwm-native-desktops.json for this instance, publishes the shared count once, clears the guard after 60 s
design.crashLoopGuard: a pending guard from another instance at start means the previous start did not stabilise: opt-in switched off, notification, no load
design.countDelivery: skin.json sharedSettings prerequisite is now the opt-in file; native_workspaces delivers only when the provider is loaded in this Hyprland instance (runtime marker) and otherwise reports inactive; the dispatcher retries only pending deliveries (not applied, not inactive), so no periodic python polling after success or while not loaded
design.scope: enabled in every skin once loaded (one provider generation per module lifetime); never loaded/unloaded on skin change

install.method: make install (temporary + atomic mv) while the module was NOT loaded in the session
